thread:
Priya: Planning note: PEN-2026 retest window proposed 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC, 2h. Single assessor, ephemeral role, KMS alias for decrypt. @Sam can you drive ops?
Sam: Yep. Need exact IAM JSON and svc accounts to tag. Hot standby export node OK.
Priya: Minimal RBAC: role 'assessor/ephemeral' with sts:AssumeRole, read-only on prod logs, kms:Decrypt on alias/pen-test-2026. No write perms. Tag svc-pt-ingest and svc-log-exporter.
Jin: Audit snapshot plan: export auth_events, kms_decrypt_events, deploy_events as parquet, upload to s3://redwood-pt-exports/pen-2026/ with sha256 manifest. If export >10m we use temporary replica.
Jin: Quick export example:
pg_dump --table=auth_events --data-only -h audit-db.internal -f auth_events.sql
aws s3 cp auth_events.sql s3://redwood-pt-exports/pen-2026/
sha256sum auth_events.sql > auth_events.sha256
Alex: Triage process: canonical JIRA epic SEC-PT-2026. Each finding must have a PR with repro steps, test vector, rollback notes. Link fixes to retest ticket.
Priya: KMS: create alias/pen-test-2026, update key policy to allow kms:Decrypt only for assessor role. Separate CloudTrail for the retest bucket.
Sam: Ops checklist draft: create assessor role (ttl 2h); create alias and key policy; snapshot audit DB + upload manifest; provision read-only export node; open presigned S3 access (1h after assume). Will run if PRIYA+JIN+ALEX ack.
Priya: Ack. Jin owns snapshot+manifest. Alex owns JIRA epic. Sam owns role+presigned window.
assessor-bot: Dry-run scheduled 2026-03-28 16:00 UTC (DRY-RUN-5987). Run full checklist against staging and report timing.
Jin: Running dry-run. If it times out >10m we'll use replica.
Alex: Add gating test: run exploit repro against patched canary, expect no reproduction. Include expected sample output in ticket.
Priya: I'll attach minimal repro to SEC-PT-2026 today.
Sam: If dry-run passes I'll post prod calendar invite to #eng-security and #oncall.
Priya: Acceptance criteria for retest: 1) assessor can assume role and only see allowed artifacts; 2) KMS decrypt events appear in CloudTrail snapshot; 3) repro fails against patched image; 4) PRs include regression tests. On failure, pause retest and investigate (no partial sign-offs).
Alex: Adding label "retest-required" to blocking PRs so release bot blocks auto-deploys until cleared.
Priya: I'll follow up with a short runbook and IAM snippets. :thumbsup: 
Sam: :thumbsup: 
Jin: :thumbsup: 
assessor-bot: Reminder set for dry-run 2026-03-28 15:30 UTC.
